Live the Villanova Dream — La Rosa 2 | 4BR + Maid | Single Row | Private Garden

Wake up to greenery and tranquility in this beautifully positioned 4-bedroom villa in La Rosa 2, one of Villanova's most desirable clusters.

Sitting on a generous 3,023 sq.ft plot with 2,324 sq.ft of living space, this single-row home offers the privacy you've been looking for — no neighbours directly behind, just lush green views and peaceful surroundings.

Steps from the community pool and park, and close to everything Villanova has to offer.

Highlights:
⦁ 4 Bedrooms + Maid's Room
⦁ Single Row — extra privacy & unobstructed views
⦁ Private Garden | 3,023 sq.ft Plot
⦁ 2,324 sq.ft BUA
⦁ Short walk to pool & park
⦁ Access to Villanova Community Mall, sports courts & walking trails
⦁ 20 mins to Downtown Dubai & DXB Airport

Located in Dubailand with direct access via Emirates Road and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road — perfectly connected, yet beautifully removed from the city buzz.

Contact Ahmed at Provident Real Estate to book your viewing today.
